Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.
Nothing on screen changes for 3.38 s (0.25–3.63 s): start the next move within 3 s, or put data-hold on the element whose stillness is deliberate; see references/motion.md.

Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 11 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "Hard cap for memory control" at 14 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
